hooks.command: bash -c 'p=hooks/dispatch.sh; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "$PWD" "$PWD/plugins/saas-startup-team" "${HOME:-/dev/null}/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/"*/plugins/saas-startup-team; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/$p" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/gate.sh" ] && [ -f "$r/scripts/pii-gate.sh" ] && exec bash "$r/$p" pre-write; done; cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then echo "[saas-startup-team] hook target unavailable: $p (reinstall or rebind plugin)" >&2; else echo "[saas-startup-team] plugin root unset; skipping $p (rebind after marketplace update)" >&2; fi; exit 0'
hooks.description: Path-scoped pre-write gates when content is present: secrets, JSON schema, ad spend (fail closed); LinkedIn advisory

hooks.description: Block incident-linked gh pr merge without a regression test (or override)

hooks.command: bash -c 'p=hooks/dispatch.sh; for r in "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do [ -n "$r" ] && [ -f "$r/$p" ] && exec bash "$r/$p" post-write; done; [ -f "$PWD/$p" ] && [ -f "$PWD/scripts/gate.sh" ] && exec bash "$PWD/$p" post-write; cat >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo "[saas-startup-team] hook target not found: $p" >&2; exit 0'
